claims: NASA launched the Artemis II mission on April 1, 2026.
The Artemis II mission launched at 6:35 p.m. EDT.
The Artemis II mission launched from Launch Pad 39B at the Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
The Artemis II mission lifted off on a Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
The Artemis II mission sent four astronauts on a 10-day test flight around the Moon.
The Artemis II mission duration is 10 days (approx.).
The crew of the Artemis II mission is Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
The Artemis II mission is the first crewed flight of the Orion spacecraft.
The Artemis II mission is the first crewed mission beyond low Earth orbit since Apollo 17 in 1972.
